The implementer's round-6 proof is the hermetic suite alone (no run directory, no log artifact), so the fallback of verifying a record against its raw output had nothing to verify; and the namespace was INFRA-707's from 19:27Z, with that tester's own estimate of 21:10Z for the third attempt at a reading its acceptance needs whole. The behaviour is covered by case (w), whose red and green states I measured myself, and the reference-seed rerun will run this code for hours on a real pod. I can drive the live check after INFRA-707's down lands if the architect wants it before approval; nothing of this round waits on it.

A step killed on a real pod still leaves its runner job loading the copy until the job ends by itself - round 4's measurement, documented at this head in loadtest/README.md with the two kubectl exec lines that stop it by pid. This fix changes who stops that job (nobody, rather than a dead step's wait stopping a live run's), not whether it keeps running.
